task1.title: Number of participants by activity at a Melbourne social centre (2000–2020)
task1.prompt: The graph below gives information on the numbers of participants for different activities at one social centre in Melbourne, Australia for the period 2000 to 2020.

chartDesc.title: Number of participants, by activity 2000–2020
chartDesc.overview: Film club was consistently the most popular activity throughout the 20-year period, while Table tennis saw a dramatic rise in participants to become the second most popular by 2020. In contrast, participation in Amateur dramatics plummeted over the same timeframe.
keyFeatures: Film club retained the highest number of participants across all years, fluctuating between 60 (in 2010) and 66 (in 2020).
Table tennis participation experienced the largest overall increase, rising dramatically from 16 in 2000 to 54 in 2020.
Amateur dramatics experienced the steepest decline, dropping from a peak of 28 participants in 2005 to just 6 in 2020.
Musical performances introduced in 2005 (0 participants) grew steadily to reach 18 participants by 2020.
Martial arts fluctuated slightly within a narrow range between 32 and 38 participants over the 20 years.

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

task2.title: Competition versus cooperation
task2.prompt:
Some people think that competition at work, at school and in daily life is a good thing. Others believe that we should try to cooperate more, rather than competing against each other.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
task2.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
